global_prompt: A single continuous cinematic tracking shot of a massive dragon Smooth natural flight dynamics, realistic wing movements, cinematic lighting, strong temporal continuity, and no cuts, teleportation, or sudden scene changes.
local_prompts: A massive dragon soars high above a vast mountain range, flapping its enormous wings steadily. The camera tracks alongside the dragon, capturing its powerful wing movements as it glides smoothly through the sky. The dragon maintains a steady altitude while distant mountain peaks pass below.

The dragon gradually begins descending toward a tall rocky mountain peak. The dragon approaches the rocky peak and gently touches down with its claws. Its legs absorb the landing as its wings gradually fold against its body. The dragon settles into a stable standing position on the mountain peak, looking out across the surrounding mountains.
